question: In 1928, Vallabhbhai Patel led the peasant movement in ______, a taluka in Gujarat, against enhancement of land revenue.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bardoli**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bardoli** is the taluka in Gujarat where Vallabhbhai Patel led the peasant movement against the enhancement of land revenue in 1928.
 
• Th is movement, known as the Bardoli Satyagraha, was a significant milestone in India's struggle for independence.
 
• Due to the flood, ignoring the plight of the farmers, the Bombay Presidency increased the tax rates by 22%, resulting in the Bardoli Satyagraha.
 
• In January 1928, farmers in Bardoli invited Vallabhai Patel to launch a protest movement, in which they all took a pledge not to pay taxes.
 
• A large number of women took an active part in the movement.
 
• **It was these women who gave Patel the nickname Sardar.**
 
• The **movement focused** on the conditions of the rich and middle-class farmers and largely neglected the poor farmers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vallabhbhai Patel**

 
 
• Vallabhbhai Patel, known as the "Iron Man of India," was a prominent Indian statesman and freedom fighter.
 
• He played a crucial role in uniting India after independence.
 
• He negotiated with hundreds of princely states, persuading most of them to join the Indian Union.
 
• He was a dedicated follower of Mahatma Gandhi and participated in several civil disobedience movements against British rule.
 
• His leadership in the Kheda and Bardoli satyagrahas demonstrated his courage and commitment to the Indian independence struggle.
